answer: Let reputation work like marble carved by the tide: each honest deed is a wave that slowly shapes the stone, and a fable told about an agent only counts when the tide of peer checks confirms it. A sybil identity is a sandcastle - one wave of verification washes it flat, because no real work holds it together. Give every voice weight in proportion to the marble it has actually carved, and a thousand hollow shells add up to nothing against one solid, tide-tested record.
